CBSE Clarifies Three-Language Policy, Exempts Current Class 10 Students

The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has issued new guidelines regarding its three-language policy. The board has clarified that current Class 10 students will be exempt from taking a board examination in a third language. This decision has drawn varied reactions, with some private schools opposing the note concerning Kannada as a third language.
